theme_and_vibe.mood: Immersive, intimate, refined, minimal, highly visual
design_principles: Artwork comes before everything. Let negative space breathe.
Never look like a generic e-commerce store or SaaS template.
Use typography to dictate rhythm and structure.
Subtle, kinetic, deliberate motion. No erratic or bouncy animations.

surface.description: Muted ash/soft grey for secondary backgrounds.

text.description: Deep graphite/charcoal black for primary headings and statements.

text_secondary.description: Soft ash/muted grey for secondary text and descriptions.

accent.description: Smoky olive / restrained warm taupe for subtle accents, borders, or hover states.

primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, large editorial statements, hero text.
primary_heading.weight: Light or Regular. Never heavy bold.
primary_heading.instructions: Use tighter tracking for oversized headings. No inter or generic sans.

secondary_body.usage: Nav, body text, forms, functional UI.

accent.usage: Numbered manifesto chapters, tiny labels, captions.

grids_layouts.general: Asymmetrical, editorial masonry. Avoid rigid, equal-sized bootstrap columns.
grids_layouts.spacing_scale: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical web design. p-12, p-24, p-32.
grids_layouts.gallery: Editorial masonry with deliberate spotlighting. Some images span 2 columns, some are small with massive negative space.

component_styling.buttons: Sharp edges, flat. No pill shapes for this specific theme. 1px solid border. Hover state fills background with charcoal, text turns ivory.
component_styling.cards: NO glossy cards. NO heavy shadows. Use flat, rectangular geometries. 1px subtle borders if necessary.
component_styling.forms: Minimalist. Bottom border only for inputs (like a paper line), no fully enclosed boxes. No rounded corners.
component_styling.navigation: Sticky, quiet header. Transparent over hero, then blurred paper background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F6F4F0]/80) on scroll. Mobile uses full-screen menu overlay.
component_styling.header_critical_rule: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header once scrolled. Must have backdrop blur + semi-solid tint.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain/noise overlay on the entire body to mimic charcoal paper (pointer-events-none).
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: Deliberate spotlight/clipped-frame product photography treatment. Images should look like framed art or raw canvas.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line on-load reveal for the typography.
motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth scrolling for weight and momentum.
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer motion for subtle fade + slight vertical shift (translate-y) as elements enter viewport.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for artist statements or journal highlights using react-fast-marquee. Serif text, massive gaps.

media_and_images.rules: Never use placeholder images. Treat images like art pieces—give them padding, use subtle mattes or raw edges.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI focusing heavily on typography and negative space.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling immediately in the layout.
Use Framer Motion to orchestrate the kinetic line-by-line hero reveal.
Apply the paper texture noise overlay globally via CSS or SVG.
Adhere strictly to the color palette. No blues, no bright colors.
Ensure all components use .jsx or .js extensions, not .tsx.
Do not use Shadcn card components; construct raw HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
